query: Which feature-selection and explainability techniques (ReliefF, SHAP, saliency maps, RQA importance scores) best translate recurrence and quantile features into operator-understandable diagnostics?

response.query: Which feature-selection and explainability techniques (ReliefF, SHAP, saliency maps, RQA importance scores) best translate recurrence and quantile features into operator-understandable diagnostics?
response.answer: SHAP and saliency maps best translate recurrence and quantile features into operator-understandable diagnostics. ReliefF and RQA importance scores are useful for feature selection.
